conceptZh: 在溫馨明亮的園藝工坊中，一塊長條狀的濕潤黑土作為寬大的底部橫畫。滴入一滴水後，黑土中央驚喜地向上抽出一根筆直的褐色幼苗幹（豎畫），接著幼苗頂端平緩展開一對小木牌般的水平橫枝（較短的上橫畫），三者自然融合成結構標準、線條飽滿的「土」字。
object: A rich moist dark-soil garden bed with a sprouting terracotta stem and horizontal wooden plant marker.
morph: The wide soil bed forms the longer bottom horizontal stroke; a single water droplet causes a central soil stem to grow upward as the vertical stroke, while two horizontal wooden leaf-tags extend out to create the shorter top horizontal stroke, seamlessly fusing into the character '土'.
creativeAngle: 擺脫過去「鏟子插土並壓平」的機械拼貼模式，改以「土壤發芽成長」的自然生態因果作為核心比喻。下長橫為養分土壤，中豎為茁壯幹莖，上短橫為水平伸展的雙枝，呈現生動且符合字形比例（上短下長）的筆順動態，搭配溫柔的台灣國語發音與長達 3.5 秒的靜止定格。
promptEn:
An 8-second 3D literacy animation designed for 6-8-year-old children teaching the Traditional Chinese character '土' (earth). Set in a warm, brightly lit garden workspace against a clean, uncluttered pastel beige background with soft studio shadows.

[0.0s - 1.5s]: Centered in frame, a smooth, wide rectangular slab of dark, rich potting soil rests horizontally along the lower third of the scene, establishing the long bottom horizontal stroke. A single glossy water drop falls into the exact middle of the soil base with a gentle ripple.

[1.5s - 3.0s]: Triggered by the drop, a sleek vertical sprout of rich brown terracotta clay grows straight upward from the center, forming the sturdy vertical stroke (丨). Near its upper section, two wooden garden marker tabs smoothly extend left and right, forming a neat, shorter horizontal crossbar (一).

[3.0s - 4.5s]: The plant bed, terracotta stem, and wooden crossbar seamlessly merge and smooth into a crisp, vibrant, saturated chocolate-brown Traditional Chinese glyph '土'. The top horizontal stroke is visibly shorter than the wide bottom foundation stroke. The finished character fills approximately 70% of the screen height, perfectly centered with clean margins around all edges.

[4.5s - 8.0s]: The character '土' remains completely static and rock-steady for a 3.5-second final hold. Clear, warm Taiwanese Mandarin voiceover distinctly pronounces 'ㄊㄨˇ' (tǔ) four times in a friendly, encouraging rhythm ('ㄊㄨˇ, ㄊㄨˇ, ㄊㄨˇ, ㄊㄨˇ'). Clean visual composition without watermarks, floating text, or flashing effects.

conceptZh: 短手橡膠恐龍想清掉泥土字上的浮土，怎麼伸都碰不到；改用大腳一掃，字清乾淨了，自己卻轉成小陀螺。
object: One shallow pale-tan soil slab containing a raised, solid terracotta-brown 土, lightly covered with loose soil.
morph: An oversized rubber foot brushes loose soil away to reveal the intact raised glyph; its three strokes never change shape.
creativeAngle: 改用掃土揭字，避開幼苗長成筆畫的舊構想。恐龍的小手清不到、大腳掃過頭，把自己轉成陀螺；笑點結束後，完整字形穩定停留四秒。
promptEn:
Create an exactly 8-second stylized 3D animation featuring an original, proudly meticulous rubber dinosaur with enormous paddle-shaped feet, comically tiny arms, and a springy mint-green body. Its only supporting object is a shallow pale-tan soil slab containing a raised Traditional Chinese glyph 土 made from compacted, saturated terracotta-brown earth. A thin layer of loose soil partly conceals the raised strokes. Use a locked, nearly overhead camera, warm studio lighting, a light cream background, and generous clear margins. Keep the slab and teaching subject centered and uncropped throughout.

From 0.0–1.7 seconds, the dinosaur stands beside the slab, determined to tidy it. It leans forward and stretches both tiny arms toward the dusty upper crossbar. Its enormous feet keep its body too far away: the fingertips paddle helplessly in empty space. It pauses, looks from its useless arms to one huge foot, and raises an eyebrow.

From 1.7–3.3 seconds, it carefully extends that foot over the slab, then makes one excessively enthusiastic sideways sweep. The broad rubber sole brushes the loose surface soil completely off the raised letter and beyond the frame. The effort spins the dinosaur on its other foot through one quick, rubbery pirouette; its tiny arms stick straight out as though they could possibly help. Use a soft brushing sound and a gentle squeak, without a startling impact.

By 4.0 seconds, the dinosaur settles just outside the slab at the lower-right margin and gives a sheepish, motionless bow. The revealed 土 is pristine and frontally legible: one short upper horizontal, one straight central vertical extending above that horizontal and meeting the longer bottom horizontal. All three strokes join cleanly. Use flat, evenly colored stroke faces with subtle earth texture and minimal shadows, so the shape reads immediately. The finished glyph occupies approximately 70% of frame height.

Hold this exact composition completely still from 4.0–8.0 seconds. A warm, friendly off-screen voice speaks clear Taiwanese Mandarin, saying exactly: 「土、土、泥土」. Place the first 土 around 4.2 seconds, the second around 5.2 seconds, and 泥土 around 6.4–7.2 seconds, with natural short pauses. Stop after the word. Only the single glyph 土 appears on screen; the vocabulary is audio only. Keep the scene free of other lettering, subtitles, logos, watermarks, clutter, and flashing effects. Use no background music.
